definitions.explanation: An abstract thought or general understanding about something.
The act of giving up and accepting an inevitable outcome.

examples.japanese: ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{観念|かんねん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{困|こま}る→困る：00861_komaru⟧。
examples.english: People with no sense of time are troublesome.

examples.japanese: ⟦{固定|こてい}→固定：10996_kotei⟧{観念|かんねん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦とらわれて→囚われる：10402_torawareru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない。
examples.english: You shouldn't be bound by fixed ideas.

examples.japanese: ⟦{道徳|どうとく}→道徳：03478_doutoku⟧{観念|かんねん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{薄|うす}れて→薄れる：14107_usureru⟧きた⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It's said that moral consciousness has been weakening.

examples.japanese: ⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{逃|に}げられない→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧、{観念|かんねん}⟦しろ→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: You can't escape anymore. Give up.

examples.english: The criminal finally gave up and turned himself in.

examples.japanese: ⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{遅|おそ}い→遅い：00533_osoi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{観念|かんねん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{帰|かえ}る→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧ことにした。
examples.english: I accepted that it was too late and decided to go home.

notes:
USAGE: {観念|かんねん} has two distinct meanings depending on context.

SENSE 1 - CONCEPT:
- ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{観念|かんねん} (sense of time)
- ⟦{固定|こてい}→固定：10996_kotei⟧{観念|かんねん} (fixed idea, preconception)
- ⟦{先入観|せんにゅうかん}→先入観：07312_sennyuukan⟧/{観念|かんねん} (preconceived notion)
- ⟦{道徳|どうとく}→道徳：03478_doutoku⟧{観念|かんねん} (moral sense)

SENSE 2 - RESIGNATION:
- {観念|かんねん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to give up, resign oneself)
- {観念|かんねん}⟦しろ→する：00392_suru⟧ (Give up! - imperative)

PHILOSOPHICAL USE: In philosophy, {観念|かんねん} translates 'idea' in the philosophical sense (e.g., {観念論|かんねんろん} = idealism).

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{概念|がいねん}→概念：04709_gainen⟧ - concept (more formal/technical)
- ⟦{考|かんが}え→考え：00855_kangae⟧ - thought, idea (more casual)
